text:
eli: quick sync on private deploy roadmap. customer wants a lightweight, single-page preflight + explicit upgrade lane guarantees before signing.

nora: nailed-down asks?

eli: yes: 1) a concise preflight report (1 page) with PASS/WARN/FAIL per check and exactly one remediation sentence each; 2) manifest JSON limited to non-identifying fields; 3) upgrade lanes with rollback SLAs.

sam: for the manifest let's keep it tiny: installer_hmac, agent_semver, kernel_major, bgp_test (PASS/FAIL), outbound443 (PASS/FAIL), telemetry_opt_in (true/false). no IPs, no hostnames.

compliance: must have explicit consent line for telemetry. suggested phrasing: "I consent to share the anonymized install manifest with Redwood for support and troubleshooting." checkbox + UTC timestamp.

eli: preflight checks we should run: TCP egress to control (443/50051), TLS cert chain validation, outbound NAT detection, relay-only handshake on 443, BGP session reachability (if requested).

sam: sample CLI: `./rb-preflight --control https://control.redwood.prod --check 443,50051 --relay` which outputs human report and `manifest.json` if `--emit-manifest` set.

nora: UI: console needs a compact status card and a download button for manifest + signed consent. also show remediation bullets collapsed by default.

eli: upgrade lanes: fast lane = automated staged rollout with relay fallback, MTTR rollback target <=15m, max 2 rolling restarts. cautious lane = manual approval, extended window, MTTR <=60m. need test harness proving this in lab.

sam: rollback trigger: any health check failing >2% of nodes OR control-plane error rate spike >5% in a 5m window. auto-halt and rollback to previous snapshot.

devops-bot: ACTION: created task ONRAMP-291 assigned to sam for preflight binary PoC.

compliance: require manifest HMAC signed by our CI and include the CI artifact URL. customers asked for chain-of-custody proof.

eli: prioritization: classify as enterprise-onramp-high. timeline: PoC in 72h, runbook and console flow in 4w, lab rollback tests + customer validation in 8w.

sam: I'll post PoC link here in 48h.

nora: I'll draft the console card mock and the one-line remediation copy.

eli: acceptance criteria before we present to customer:
- preflight binary + source published (MIT-friendly)
- manifest schema published and validated by 2 pilot customers
- console status card + download flow implemented
- staged rollout automation + rollback tests pass in lab
- consent wording + CI-signed installer proof included

eli: thanks all. we'll reconvene after PoC. :rocket:
